purpose: Controlled prediction comparison of the frozen D2 text scheme (deterministic rule cleanup R1-R6 + idle-budget recovery, both frozen at analysis-text-budget-v1 commit 3e09d4b) against the EXP-011 M48T512 baseline: Aurora (aurora-model==0.2.0) zero-shot on the same frozen TimesX test split (2,474 windows, 19 domains), 3 seeds (2021/2022/2023). Only the text token ids/mask change (D0 -> D2); model, weights, windows, seeds, itl, denominators and scoring are EXP-011-identical.
scope_statement: This round evaluates the D2 input scheme AS A WHOLE: rule cleanup and budget redistribution change simultaneously, so gains cannot be attributed to either alone. Higher text coverage does NOT imply better prediction; the frozen diagnostic (results/report.md) is coverage-only. Text source, event publication timing and truncation limitations carry over unchanged from EXP-011 (protocol_mm.json).
declaration: Aurora is NOT trained or fine-tuned on TimesX. Pre-training data overlap is not audited, so no stronger claim is made. No model modification and no hyperparameter search: D2 rules, budgets and all inference settings are frozen a priori; no scheme may be selected or re-tuned based on this round's test results.

data.exp011_reference: EXP-011 M48T512 frozen baseline (branch repro-mm-timesx-v1, commit 2285a24): overall std-MSE 4.306481+/-0.001689, std-MAE 1.202691+/-0.000269 (display precision); all comparisons recompute from full-precision shards.
data.window: past = series[s:s+96], target = series[s+96:s+108], s = variables[var_key].sample_start_idx[sample_id], test list = variables[var_key].native.test
data.window_key: (var_key, sample_id) composite key; uniqueness, text-cache lookup and all alignment checks use the composite key only — never row position

model.loading: identical to EXP-010/EXP-011 load_aurora.py: sha256 verify -> state_dict key bidirectional diff vs safetensors -> load_state_dict(strict=True) -> eval() -> all params requires_grad_(False)

inference.itl_note: itl=48 identical to the frozen EXP-010 A48 baseline and EXP-011 M48T512.
inference.pred_reduction: mean over the 100-sample dim -> single point forecast (float64)
inference.text_tensor_path: text_input_ids / text_attention_mask / text_token_type_ids passed as explicit Long tensors [1,512] moved to model.device; token_type_ids all zeros; the string path text_inputs= is FORBIDDEN.

text.definition: D2 = frozen rule cleanup (R1-R6) applied to the four native field strings, then base budgets 48/270/64/128 (including block names), then idle-budget recovery. The D0 scheme itself (normalize -> '<Name>: <field>' -> first-N truncation, NO budget transfer) is defined by repro_mm_timesx_v1/protocol_mm.json and is NOT restated as current here.
text.cleanup_rules: d2_rules.json (frozen, md5 in d2_provenance): R1 scenario-prefix rewrite (keep period dates, drop boilerplate), R2 delete bare numeric citation brackets, R3 background template compression to 'Background: {name}; domain: {domain}; frequency: {freq}.' (unparsed kept verbatim), R4 covariate-prefix compression, R5 holiday-prefix compression, R6 whitespace repair. PRESERVED, never deleted: <N> event tags, event bodies, all numbers/dates/units/negation/forecast wording, covariate statistics.
text.budget_rule: Base allocation min(raw_tokens, budget) per block (Background 48 / Events 270 / Calendar 64 / Covariates 128, budgets INCLUDE block names); leftover content budget (510 - sum) redistributed to still-truncated blocks in the FIXED order Events -> Covariates -> Calendar -> Background; invariant alloc >= base for every block; sum <= 510.
assembly_rules: apply frozen cleanup rules to each field, then whitespace-normalize; skip a block if empty or the literal 'Unknown' (same skip rule as EXP-011)
per block, tokenize '<Name>: <cleaned field>' with the in-package bert_config BertTokenizer, add_special_tokens=False
allocate tokens per budget_rule (base budgets + fixed-order idle recovery)
fixed order Background -> Events -> Calendar -> Covariates; [CLS] + content + [SEP]; right-pad to 512 (pad id 0, attention mask 0)

tokenizer.kind: BertTokenizer (slow) shipped in the aurora package: aurora/bert_config/, local_files_only=True, do_lower_case=true, model_max_length=512

cache.schema: ids int32 [2474,512], mask int32 [2474,512], explicit key arrays var_keys/sample_ids/domains; meta line per window: D2 trace record (per-block raw/cleaned/alloc token counts, [start,end) boundaries, event/covariate coverage, decoded D2 input)
cache.provenance: extracted bitwise by repro_mm_timesx_d2/build_cache_d2.py from the frozen diagnostic trace analysis/text_budget_v1/outputs/trace_D2.npz (sha256 e601f22d4c22f0bab6563cb04f387ebbc4981b9531372f88d669d81ef9d153ed) restricted to manifest native.test; key set == EXP-011 frozen cache == test_rows(); D0 trace rows verified bitwise against the EXP-011 frozen cache; decoded text is for inspection only and is NEVER re-tokenized for prediction.

seeds.application: torch.manual_seed(w) immediately before each window's generate() call; no other RNG consumption between seeding and generate(); rule and prefix IDENTICAL to EXP-010/EXP-011 so seeds pair with both baselines. The official seed set is EXACTLY these three; no other seeds may be run or reported.

determinism.timing: CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=':4096:8' must be set in process env BEFORE any CUDA initialization; torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True), torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32=False, torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32=False, torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark=False must all be applied BEFORE the first inference call.
determinism.error_policy: If a determinism error names a specific op, record the op and the disposition in the preflight report; never silently fall back to warn_only.

scoring.window_d: d = pstdev(past96, ddof=0); if d < 1e-8: d = fallback_std (precomputed in split_manifest per variable from first training sample past-96)
scoring.std_mse: mean(((pred - target)/d)^2) per window -> mean per variable -> equal weight within domain -> equal weight across 19 domains
scoring.std_mae: mean(|pred - target|/d) with the same aggregation ladder
scoring.d_vs_revin_note: The scoring denominator d (pstdev with fallback) and Aurora's internal RevIN scale are distinct quantities; never interchanged.
scoring.paired_delta_ladder: PAIRED COMPARISON = M48T512_D2 - EXP-011 M48T512 (same seed, same composite key): window-level paired difference -> mean per variable -> equal weight within domain -> equal weight across 19 domains -> overall. NEVER a plain average over all windows. Negative delta = D2 improves. Relative changes and improved domain/variable counts reported alongside; best seed never selected. A48 and Z0 appear as pre-existing reference columns only (no new inference).

shard_fingerprint.resume_policy: On resume, every header field is re-verified against the current protocol; ANY mismatch -> shard is NOT reused, moved to repro_mm_timesx_d2/predictions/quarantine/ (never deleted), and re-generated.
shard_fingerprint.done_marker: .done JSON with the same fingerprint is written only after atomic shard completion

outputs.npz_schema: sample_ids/var_keys/domains (str), pred(N,12 float64), target(N,12 float64), d(N, float64), sharded by (base_seed, domain) under repro_mm_timesx_d2/predictions/ with method tag M48T512_D2
outputs.aggregate: repro_mm_timesx_d2/results/: per-seed, variable-level, 19-domain and overall (mean +/- std ddof=1) for M48T512_D2; M48T512 recomputed at full precision from repro_mm_timesx_v1/predictions/ (headers re-verified); A48 from root predictions/; Z0 from data/Z0__test.npz; paired-difference tables D2 - M48T512 per the frozen ladder
outputs.coverage_check: per seed: key set equal to Z0__test.npz keys (2,474 rows); target and d recomputed from frozen data and compared bitwise; predictions finite

eval_gate.approval_flag: --i-approve-frozen-protocol <first 12 hex of sha256(protocol_d2.json)>; the EXP-010 token (580eb3c3f51d) AND the EXP-011 token (74b08ecac1ed) MUST be rejected by this driver
eval_gate.runtime_checks: all sha256 fingerprints re-verified at startup; D2 text cache npz sha + key set equality with the 2,474 frozen test rows; GPU >= 20 GB free; test window count == 2474
eval_gate.status: official full run (2,474 windows x seeds 2021/2022/2023) pre-authorized by the user AFTER all preflight sections pass on this frozen configuration
